blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Language models in customer-facing products must be continually updated, since the data they serve shifts over time. As retraining on the full accumulated data is impractical, each update should instead run on a small set of examples carrying the training signal of all data seen so far. The strongest current methods build this set by gradient matching, which synthesizes examples whose training gradients match those of the full data. However, they require ground-truth labels, run once on a fixed snapshot rather than on a growing stream, and are slow on large data. We introduce \textbf{OLGA}, which lifts these limitations. It distills unlabeled data by drawing the gradient matching targets from the model's own next-token predictions. Across five text classification benchmarks with phi-1.5, it improves accuracy by 10 percentage points over the strongest selection baseline using as few as five examples. OLGA also distills online data streams by keeping a running rehearsal memory of synthetic examples, which is re-distilled together with each new batch as it arrives. In the online setting, it outperforms the strongest selection-based continual baseline by 6.6 stream-AUC percentage points. Finally, our method scales to large data by pairing distillation with selection in a hybrid pipeline, letting selection handle the mild stage of compression and distillation the extreme one. It cuts runtime by 30\% versus distillation alone at similar accuracy, and beats the best selection-only pipeline by up to 12.6 percentage points.
blocks.zh: 客户服务产品中的语言模式必须不断更新,因为这些数据服务于时间变化。 由于对全部累积数据进行再培训是不切实际的,因此每次更新应使用一小组实例,其中包含迄今所看到的所有数据的培训信号。 最强的当前方法通过梯度匹配来构建此集,它综合了那些训练梯度与完整数据梯度相匹配的例子. 然而,它们需要地面真实的标签,在固定的快照上运行一次而不是在不断增长的溪流上运行,在大数据上缓慢. 我们介绍\textbf{OLGA},解除了这些限制。 它通过从模型本身的相邻预测中取出梯度匹配目标来分泌未贴标签的数据. 在使用hi-1.5的5个文本分类基准中,它比最强的选择基线提高了10个百分点,仅举出5个例子。 OLGA也通过保持合成实例的运行中排练内存来提炼出在线数据流,在到达时会和每批新数据一起被重新分解. 在在线环境下,它的业绩超过了以甄选为基础的最强持续基线6.6分。 最后,我们的方法将蒸馏与混合管道中的选择进行配对,使选择能够处理压缩和蒸馏的温和阶段。 它以相近的精度将运行时间缩短了30分,而仅是蒸馏,并击败了最佳的唯选管线,最高可达12.6%.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Language models are increasingly deployed in customer-facing products, where the traffic they serve keeps changing. User preferences move, new topics appear, and safety requirements shift, so a model that was accurate at release gradually falls out of step with the data it now sees ( Lazaridou et al., 2021 ) . Keeping it current means updating it repeatedly rather than once, and the data available at each update grows with every cycle. Retraining on every example accumulated so far is the obvious remedy and also the least affordable one, because a full pass costs more as the data grows while the oldest examples contribute least. What a practical update loop needs instead is a small set of examples, rebuilt at each cycle, that still carries the training signal of everything seen so far.
blocks.zh: 语言模型越来越多地部署在客户服务的产品中,在这些产品的流量不断发生变化。 用户偏好移动,新话题出现,安全要求也随之变化,因此在发布时准确的模型逐渐与其现在看到的数据脱节(Lazaridou等人,2021年). 保持更新意味着反复更新而不是一次更新,每次更新时提供的数据随周期而增加。 对迄今所积累的每一个例子进行再培训是明显的补救办法,也是最负担得起的办法,因为随着数据的增长,全额通过费用增加,而最古老的例子的贡献最小。 实际更新循环需要的是一小组例子,在每个周期重建,这些例子仍然带有迄今所看到的一切的训练信号。

blocks.en: Most existing methods build that set by selecting a well-chosen subset of the real examples. This works well when the budget is generous, but once only a few examples can be kept, it becomes hard to preserve a strong training signal. Dataset distillation with gradient matching addresses this by synthesizing examples whose training gradient matches the gradient of the real data ( Zhao et al., 2021 ) . Because a synthetic example does not have to be a real sentence, it can capture what many real examples teach the model, so the set can be kept to a few examples.
blocks.zh: 大多数现有方法都是通过选择真实实例的精选子集来构建设置的. 当预算慷慨的时候,这效果很好,但只有几个例子可以保留,就很难保持强大的培训信号。 带有梯度匹配的数据集蒸馏通过合成其训练梯度与真实数据的梯度相匹配的示例来解决这个问题(赵等人,2021年). 因为合成的例子不一定是真正的句子,所以可以捕捉到许多真实的例子教给模型的东西,所以集可以保存到几个例子中.

blocks.en: Three obstacles stand in the way of using gradient matching to keep a language model current. First, it needs ground-truth labels, which rules out the unlabeled data that makes up most of what a deployed system collects. For images, recent work replaces the labels with targets from a frozen model trained without them ( Lee et al., 2024 ; Joshi et al., 2025 ) , but text distillation methods still rely on labels ( Ogawa et al., 2025 ) . Second, it runs once over a fixed snapshot, so it never has to fold an arriving batch into an existing set. Methods that do this exist for images ( Gu et al., 2024 ) , but they need labels and nudge pixel values in small steps, which does not work for the discrete tokens of text. Finally, the cost of matching gradients grows with the amount of data it compresses, making it least affordable exactly when data is plentiful. For images, discarding part of the real data before distilling cuts this cost ( Xu et al., 2024 ; Moser et al., 2025 ) , but these methods rank examples by their loss against a label and have only been studied on a fixed snapshot. As a result, no existing method compresses an unlabeled text stream into a small training set at a cost that stays affordable as the stream grows.
blocks.zh: 三个障碍阻碍着使用梯度匹配来保持语言模型流畅. 首先,它需要地面真实的标签,它排除了未贴标签的数据,这些数据构成一个部署的系统收集的大部分内容。 对于图像,近期的作品用未经培训的冷冻模型中的目标取代标签(Lee等人,2024年;Joshi等人,2025年),但文本蒸馏方法仍然依赖于标签(Ogawa等人,2025年)。 第二,它运行一次 在一个固定的快照, 所以它从来没有 折叠一个到达的批 成一个现有的集。 图像中存在这样做的方法(Gu等人,2024年),但它们需要标签和微软像素值的小步骤,这对文本的离散符号不起作用. 最后,与梯度相匹配的成本随着其压缩的数据量而增加,在数据充裕时,它最不能够负担。 对于图像,在蒸馏之前丢弃部分真实数据会降低这一成本(徐等人,2024年;莫泽尔等人,2025年),但这些方法根据标签的丢失排序实例,并且只在固定快照上研究过. 因此,没有现有的方法可以将一个没有标签的文本流压缩成一个小的训练集,成本随着流的增大而保持可承受.

blocks.en: We remove all three obstacles at once. To drop the labels, we keep them out of the objective and take the matching target from the model’s own predictions instead. To move from a snapshot to a stream, we keep a running rehearsal memory of synthetic examples and merge each arriving batch into it with the same gradient matching objective. To control the cost, we introduce a hybrid pipeline in which cheap unsupervised selection runs ahead of expensive distillation, since the two are strong at different amounts of compression.
blocks.zh: 我们同时消除所有三个障碍。 为了降低标签,我们不让他们进入目标,而是从模型本身的预测中取出匹配的目标。 为了从一个快照转向一个流,我们保留着一个运行中的合成实例的排练内存,并将每个到达的批次合并到其中,并具有相同的梯度匹配目标. 为了控制成本,我们引入了一条混合管道,在这条管道中,廉价的无监督选择先于昂贵的蒸馏,因为两者在不同的压缩量下是坚固的.

blocks.en: We make the following contributions.
blocks.zh: 我们作出以下贡献。

blocks.en: • We introduce a label-free gradient matching objective whose compact distilled set trains a model 10 points more accurate than the best real subset of the same size. • We extend text distillation to streaming data, updating a rehearsal memory as each batch arrives, and beat the best real memory of the same size by 6.6 stream-AUC points. • We design a hybrid pipeline in which cheap selection shrinks each batch before distillation, cutting distillation runtime by 30% compared with distilling the full batch.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们引入了无标签梯度匹配目标,其紧凑的蒸馏集训练的10分模型比同样大小的最好真实子集更准确. ^ 我们把文本蒸馏扩展为流数据,在每个批次到达时更新一个排练内存,并以6.6个流-AUC点击败相同大小的最佳真实内存. 我们设计了一个混合管道, 便宜的选择在蒸馏前缩小每批, 将蒸馏运行时间与蒸馏整批时间相比减少30%。

blocks.zh: 我们引入了一个无标签的梯度匹配目标, 其紧凑的蒸馏集训练的模型 10 点比同样大小的最好的真正的子集更准确。

blocks.en: 2 Background and Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 背景和有关工作

blocks.en: For much of the past decade, progress in deep learning came from scale, with larger models trained on more data consistently outperforming smaller ones. As models have grown to billions of parameters and corpora to trillions of tokens, however, the bottleneck has shifted from data availability to compute and time. Deployed models must also be updated ever more often as user preferences, knowledge, and safety requirements change, and retraining on the full corpus at every update is prohibitively expensive. The question is therefore no longer how to collect more data, but how to select or construct the smallest set of examples that preserves the training signal of the full corpus.
blocks.zh: 在过去十年的大部分时间里,深入学习的进展来自规模,在更多的数据方面训练了更大的模型,这些模型的业绩一直高于较小的模型。 然而,随着模型发展到数十亿参数和数万亿令牌,瓶颈已经从数据可用性转向计算和时间。 随着用户的喜好、知识和安全要求的改变,必须更经常地更新已部署的模型,而且每次更新时对全套软件的再培训费用高昂。 因此,问题不再在于如何收集更多数据,而是如何选择或构建一套能保存完整体的培训信号的最小实例。

blocks.en: Coreset selection keeps the most representative slice of the real training set without modifying any examples. Geometry-based algorithms formalize this as a coverage problem, where k-center greedy ( Sener & Savarese, 2018 ) picks the point farthest from the selected set, while herding ( Rebuffi et al., 2017 ) and prototypical selection ( Snell et al., 2017 ) sequentially choose samples that best approximate the per-class feature centroid. Training-oriented variants use model-dependent signals such as gradient norms (GraNd) or L2 prediction error (EL2N) ( Paul et al., 2021 ) to prioritize samples near the decision boundary rather than near the class mean. Despite this diversity, all coreset methods share a hard representational ceiling, since a text sequence is an atomic unit that cannot be perturbed below the token level and no selection rule can manufacture variance that does not already exist in the chosen sample. This ceiling becomes binding at extreme compression, the regime where synthetic examples become necessary.
blocks.zh: Coreset选择保留了真正训练集中最具代表性的部分,而不修改任何实例. 基于几何的算法将这一点正式确定为覆盖问题,其中k-center贪婪(Sener & Savarese, 2018)从选定的集中选择最远的点,而放牧(Rebuffi等人, 2017年)和原型选择(Snell等人, 2017年)则依次选择最接近每类特征百分点的样本. 面向培训的变体使用梯度规范(GRANd)或L2预测误差(EL2N)(Paul等人,2021年)等模型依赖的信号,在决定边界附近而不是在类平均值附近优先采集样本. 尽管有这种多样性,所有的核心集方法都有一个硬代表上限,因为文本序列是一个原子单位,不能被扰动于符号水平以下,任何选择规则都不能制造在所选样本中不存在的差异. 这种上限在极端压缩时具有约束力,而人工合成的例子就成为必要。

blocks.en: Dataset distillation compresses a large training set into a handful of synthetic examples, optimized so that a model trained on them behaves like one trained on the original data. Wang et al. (2018) first framed this as bi-level meta-learning, updating the synthetic examples through an unrolled inner training loop, but the memory cost and numerical instability of unrolling restrict it to shallow networks trained for only a few steps. Later work replaces the unroll with cheaper surrogate objectives. Trajectory matching ( Cazenavette et al., 2022 ) aligns the parameter path traced by training on synthetic data with paths recorded on real data, at the cost of pre-computing and caching thousands of such expert trajectories. Distribution matching ( Zhao & Bilen, 2023 ) instead matches per-class feature embeddings of real and synthetic examples, which is cheap but ignores the task loss and can leave class boundaries misaligned. Gradient matching ( Zhao et al., 2021 ) targets the task loss directly by finding synthetic examples whose per-step parameter gradient matches the real gradient in cosine distance. It needs neither long unrolls nor stored trajectories and scales to larger architectures more readily, making it the dominant paradigm. All three directions, however, assume that gradients flow through a continuous input space, which holds for images but breaks down for discrete text tokens, where a gradient step on the input has no direct meaning.
blocks.zh: 数据集蒸馏将一个大型的训练集压缩成几个合成的例子,优化后,一个受过训练的模型就表现得像一个受过原始数据训练的模型. Wang等人(2018年)首先将此设定为双层元学习,通过未滚动的内训循环更新合成实例,但未滚动的内存成本和数值不稳定性限制在仅几个步骤训练的浅层网络上. 后来的作品用更便宜的代位目标取代了不卷. 轨迹比对(Cazenavette等人,2022年)将合成数据培训所追踪的参数路径与真实数据记录的路径相匹配,其代价是预先计算和挤压数千个此类专家轨迹。 发行配对(Zhao & Bilen, 2023)转而匹配每个类的特性嵌入了真实和合成的例子,这虽然便宜,但忽略了任务损失,可以让类边界错配. 渐变匹配(Zhao et al., 2021)直接针对任务损失,方法是找到其每步参数梯度与余弦距离中真实梯度相匹配的合成实例. 它不需要长卷或存储的轨迹和尺度更方便地用于更大的建筑,使它成为主导范式. 然而,所有三个方向都假设梯度流经一个连续的输入空间,该空间为图像所持有,但为离散的文本符号而分解,其中输入的梯度步骤没有直接意义.

blocks.en: Early work on distilling text avoided discreteness by optimizing continuous word embeddings instead of tokens ( Maekawa et al., 2023 ) , but the results are model-specific, meaning a synthetic embedding created with BERT cannot be used to fine-tune RoBERTa, and projecting the optimized embeddings back to the nearest vocabulary token yields incoherent sequences that carry little training signal. Maekawa et al. (2024) addressed this with DiLM, which trains a proxy generative model to synthesize readable text, routing gradients through the discrete bottleneck via generation probabilities and producing sequences that transfer across architectures. Training a full proxy language model as a distillation scaffold is itself expensive, however, and the proxy may memorize sensitive training-set content. GradMM ( Nguyen et al., 2025 ) avoids the proxy by applying the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) ( Boyd et al., 2011 ) , in which gradient matching proceeds in continuous embedding space while a periodic projection step snaps each embedding back to its nearest vocabulary token, enforcing hard discreteness throughout optimization. This produces human-readable, cross-architecture synthetic text, and it is the offline supervised technique we build on here. Like every text distillation method so far, however, it places ground-truth labels in the matching objective, which ties the distilled data to a single task and excludes the unlabeled data that makes up most of what language models are trained on.
blocks.zh: 早期关于蒸馏文本的工作通过优化连续字嵌入而不是符号(Maekawa等人,2023年)避免了离散性,但结果是模式特异性的,意思是用BERT创建的合成嵌入不能用来微调RoBERTA,并预测优化嵌入回最近的词汇符号产量不连贯的序列,很少带训练信号. Maekawa等人(2024年)用DiLM处理了这个问题,DiLM培训了一种代用基因模型,以合成可读文本,路由梯度通过离散的瓶颈通过生成概率,产生跨结构的传输序列. 然而,培训一个作为蒸馏脚手架的完全代用语言模型本身费用高昂,该代用语言可能记住敏感的训练内容。 GradMM(Nguyen等人,2025年)通过应用倍数器的转动方向法(ADMM)(Boyd等人,2011年)避免了该代词,其中梯度匹配在连续嵌入空间中进行,而周期投影步骤则将每个嵌入到最近的词汇符号上,在整个优化过程中执行硬离散. 这产生了人可读的,跨结构的合成文本, 它是我们利用的离线监督技术。 然而,与迄今为止的每一种文本蒸馏方法一样,它将地面-真实的标签放在匹配目标中,将蒸馏数据与单一任务联系起来,排除了构成语言模型培训内容的大部分的无标签数据。

blocks.en: In continual learning, a model must keep absorbing a non-stationary stream of data without losing what it has already learned. The core difficulty is catastrophic interference , in which training on new material abruptly overwrites earlier knowledge ( McCloskey & Cohen, 1989 ; French, 1999 ) , and it arises whether the stream introduces new tasks, new domains, or new classes ( van de Ven & Tolias, 2019 ) . Architecture-based methods counter it by dedicating parameters to each task ( Rusu et al., 2016 ; Mallya & Lazebnik, 2018 ) , but presuppose known task boundaries and a growing parameter budget. Regularization-based methods penalize changes to weights that matter for past tasks ( Kirkpatrick et al., 2017 ; Zenke et al., 2017 ; Li & Hoiem, 2018 ) , but weaken over long streams as their accumulated constraints stiffen the network. The dominant remedy is rehearsal , which replays a small memory of past examples alongside incoming data, with iCaRL ( Rebuffi et al., 2017 ) as its canonical instance and a strong baseline for nearly a decade. Because the memory is the method, much work concerns how to curate it, from fixed rules such as reservoir sampling, herding, or class-balanced storage ( Prabhu et al., 2020 ) to gradient-based rules that keep the examples whose gradients best span ( Aljundi et al., 2019 ) or best approximate ( Tiwari et al., 2022 ) the gradient of all data seen so far. Every such scheme still chooses among real examples, so the memory inherits the representational ceiling of coreset selection. That ceiling binds hardest where rehearsal matters most: as the stream grows and the per-class budget shrinks, a few stored examples can no longer carry the training signal of the task they stand for.
blocks.zh: 在不断学习的过程中,一个模型必须不断吸收非固定的数据流,而不失去它已经学到的东西。 核心困难是灾难性的干扰,其中新材料的培训突然覆盖了早期的知识(McCloskey & Cohen,1989年;法文,1999年),并产生流是引入新任务,新域,还是新课(van de Ven & Tolias,2019年). 基于架构的方法通过为每项任务指定参数来对抗它(Rusu等人,2016年;Mallya & Lazebnik,2018年),但前提是已知的任务界限和不断增长的参数预算. 基于规范化的方法惩罚了对过去任务重要重量的改变(Kirkpatrick等人,2017年;Zenke等人,2017年;Li & Hoiem,2018年),但随着其累积的制约因素使网络僵化,在漫长的溪流中减弱. 以 iCaRL(Rebuffi等人, 2017年)为主要方法, 由于记忆是方法,所以许多工作都涉及如何校正它,从水库取样、放牧或类平衡存储等固定规则(Prabhu等人,2020年),到保留其梯度跨度最佳的例子(Aljundi等人,2019年)或迄今为止所看到的所有数据的梯度最佳近似(Tiwari等人,2022年)。 每个这样的方案仍然在真实的例子中选择,因此内存继承了核心集选择的代表上限. 这个上限在排练最紧要的地方影响最大:随着溪流的增长和每班预算的缩减,少数存储的例子无法再携带他们所主张的任务的训练信号.

blocks.en: This ceiling motivates compressing the memory rather than selecting it, using dataset distillation to synthesize a handful of maximally informative rehearsal examples. Distilled Replay keeps as little as one synthetic pattern per class ( Rosasco et al., 2022 ) , Zhao et al. (2021) showed that gradient-matched synthetic memories alleviate forgetting in a task-incremental image setting, and later methods refine the buffer by carrying cross-task information ( Liao et al., 2025 ) , mixing distilled with real exemplars ( Kong et al., 2024 ) , or condensing prototypical exemplars ( Nguyen et al., 2026 ) . Two limitations run through this line of work. First, these methods optimize continuous pixel tensors with objectives that do not carry over to discrete tokens. Continual learning for text has therefore sidestepped distillation in favor of generative rehearsal, sampling pseudo-examples from an autoencoder ( Zeng et al., 2024 ) or prompting the model to synthesize its own rehearsal set ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , which re-incurs the expense and memorization risk of a separate generator. Second, nearly all of them are offline, distilling each task once from a complete snapshot. The one exception, SSD ( Gu et al., 2024 ) , folds each arriving batch into a synthetic image memory by matching gradients against the labeled batch. How to fold an arriving batch into a synthetic memory of discrete tokens, with or without labels, has not been studied.
blocks.zh: 这种天花板激发了对内存的压缩而不是选择,利用数据集的蒸馏来合成少数内容最丰富的排练实例. Distilled Replay保存的每类合成图案不多(Rosasco等人,2022年),Zhao等人(2021年)表明,梯度匹配的合成记忆在任务递增的图像设定中减轻了遗忘,后来的方法通过携带交叉任务信息(廖等人,2025年),将蒸馏物与真实的样本混合(Kong等人,2024年),或缩合的典型实例(Nguyen等人,2026年)来完善缓冲物. 这项工作有两个限制。 首先,这些方法优化了连续的像素变压器,其目标不会结转到离散的符号上. 因此,不断学习文本后,将蒸馏分解为有利于基因排练,从自动编码器(Zeng等人,2024年)中取样伪实例,或促使模型合成自己的排练集(Huang等人,2024年),这再次影响了单独生成器的成本和记忆风险。 第二,它们几乎都离线了, 从一个完整的快照中提炼出每个任务一次。 一个例外是SSD(Gu等人,2024年),通过将梯度与标注的批次相匹配,将每个到达批次折叠成合成图像存储器. 如何将运抵的批次折叠成有或无标签的离散符号的合成内存,尚未研究.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of the components of OLGA. (a) Synthetic text is generated by matching its training gradient to that of real data, alternating with a step that maps it back to real tokens. (b) A frozen language model’s next-token predictions replace ground-truth labels, so gradient matching works on unlabeled data. (c) A running rehearsal memory extends offline distillation to an online data stream. Each new batch is distilled together with the memory, which the model then retrains on. (d) Our hybrid design first uses cheap selection to shrink each batch, then distills what remains into the few examples kept, which cuts runtime on large data.
blocks.zh: 图 1:OLGA各组成部分概述. (a) 合成文本是通过使其训练梯度与真实数据梯度相匹配而生成的,并交替使用将其映射回真实符号的阶梯。 (b) 冷冻的语言模型的下一个预测取代了地面真实的标签,因此梯度比对了未贴标签的数据。 (c) 运行中的排练内存将线下蒸馏延伸至在线数据流。 每批新货都与内存一起蒸馏,然后该模型重排。 (d) 我们的混合设计首先使用廉价选择来缩小每批货物,然后将剩下的内容提炼成所保存的少数例子,从而缩短大数据的运行时间。

blocks.en: 3.4 Hybrid hierarchical compression
blocks.zh: 3.4 混合等级压缩

blocks.en: Selection and distillation work best in different regimes. When the budget is a large fraction of the data, cheap coreset selection is enough, since a well-chosen real subset still covers most of the training signal. As the budget shrinks toward a handful of examples, no real subset can carry that signal, whereas a single synthetic example can combine signal drawn from many real ones. Viewing compression as an information bottleneck ( Tishby et al., 2000 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) , we expect selection to suffice while it is wide and distillation to be needed once it narrows.
blocks.zh: 选择和蒸馏在不同制度中最有效。 当预算是数据的一大部分时,廉价的芯集选择就足够了,因为一个精选的真子集仍然覆盖大部分训练信号. 随着预算向少数例子缩水,没有一个真正的子集可以携带这个信号,而一个单一的合成例子可以结合从许多真实例子中提取的信号. 将压缩视为信息瓶颈(Tishby等人,2000年;Zhou等人,2025年),我们期望选择足够了,同时它很宽,一旦缩小就需要蒸馏。

blocks.en: We therefore compress in two stages (Figure 1 (d)). At every compression step, offline on a static pool or at each step of the stream, a coreset selector first cuts the incoming batch of B B examples down to a smaller pool of K K , and gradient matching then distills that pool into the m m examples actually kept, so B ≫ K ≫ m B\gg K\gg m . We call this the hybrid pipeline and compare it against selection-only and distillation-only alternatives in Section 4.4 .
blocks.zh: 因此,我们分两个阶段进行压缩(图1(d))。 在每一个压缩步骤上,在静电池上或溪流的每个步骤下线,一个核心集选择器首先将即将到来的一批B B 实例切到一个较小的K K 池中,然后梯度匹配,然后将该池蒸馏到实际保存的m m 实例中,所以B ≫ K ≫ m B\gg K\gg m. 我们称这为混合管道,并将其与第4.4节中仅选择和蒸馏的替代品进行比较。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验装置

blocks.en: We use five text classification datasets: SST-2 ( Socher et al., 2013 ) , Rotten Tomatoes ( Pang & Lee, 2005 ) , RT-Polarity ( Pang & Lee, 2005 ) , IMDB ( Maas et al., 2011 ) , and TwitterEmotion ( Saravia et al., 2018 ) . They span two domains, movie reviews and tweets, inputs from a single sentence to a full review, and training pools from 1,000 examples to tens of thousands. Every experiment uses all five, except the streaming hybrid, whose ten steps of 1,000 examples only SST-2 and IMDB can supply. Appendix A1 details the data partitioning and stream construction.
blocks.zh: 我们使用了五个文本分类数据集:SST-2(Socher等人,2013年),罗腾番茄(Pang & Lee,2005年),RT-Polity. (Pang & Lee,2005年),IMDB (Maas等人,2011年),和TwitterEmotion (Saravia等人,2018年). 他们跨越两个领域,电影评论和推特,从一句话到全面评论的投入,以及从1 000个实例到数万人的培训集合。 每个实验都使用所有五个,除了流体杂交,其10个步骤的1000例只有SST-2和IMDB可以提供. 附录A1详细列出了数据分割和流构造.

blocks.en: Following GradMM ( Nguyen et al., 2025 ) , we use phi-1.5 ( Li et al., 2023 ) for our experiments. During distillation, we only match the gradients of the output layer to avoid recomputing the gradients of all 1.3B parameters at each step, and we run the ADMM solver for 30 outer iterations of 50 inner steps at a step size of 0.008. During fine-tuning, we train 200 steps on a linear schedule, evaluating every 50 steps and keeping the best checkpoint, with the learning rate picked per dataset from { 7 × 10 − 6 , 1 × 10 − 5 , 1.5 × 10 − 5 } \{7{\times}10^{-6},\,1{\times}10^{-5},\,1.5{\times}10^{-5}\} . While we use phi-1.5 for both distillation and fine-tuning, two different models can be used in general, without any change to the method, because what distillation returns is plain text rather than weights.
blocks.zh: 继GradMM(Nguyen等人,2025年)之后,我们用phi-1.5(Li等人,2023年)进行实验. 在蒸馏过程中,我们只匹配输出层的梯度,以避免每步重算所有1.3B参数的梯度,我们运行ADMM解码器,30外迭代50个内继,步长0.08. 在微调期间,我们按线性时间表训练200步,每50步评价一次,并保持最佳的检查点,每个数据集的学习率从{7×10×6,1×10×5,1.5×10×5}}}{10×6},\,1×10×5},\,1×10×5},\,1.5×10×5}的学习率. 虽然我们同时使用phi-1.5来进行蒸馏和微调,但一般可以使用两种不同的模型,对方法不作任何修改,因为蒸馏返回的是纯文本而不是重量.

blocks.en: In the offline setup, our main metric is accuracy after fine-tuning, and we compare against five competing methods: k-center greedy ( Sener & Savarese, 2018 ) takes the example farthest from those already picked; herding ( Rebuffi et al., 2017 ) takes the ones that keep the running mean closest to the average; prototypical ( Snell et al., 2017 ) takes the ones closest to that average; uncertainty ( Lewis & Gale, 1994 ) takes the ones the model is least sure about; and random picks uniformly. In the online setup, we focus on the area under the accuracy-versus-step curve (AUC), which rewards being right at every step rather than only the last, and we compare against four competing methods: k-center greedy, herding, and prototypical from above, and reservoir sampling ( Vitter, 1985 ) , which keeps a uniform sample of all data seen. In both settings we also report three reference points. An oracle fine-tunes on all available real data, and supervised GradMM distills with the ground-truth labels that our label-free method never sees. Together they give upper bounds, while the zero-shot model with no fine-tuning gives the lower bound.
blocks.zh: 在离线设置中,我们的主要衡量标准是微调后的精确度,我们比较了五种相互竞争的方法:k-center贪婪 (Sener & Savarese, 2018年)以与已经摘取者最远的例子为例;放牧(Rebuffi等人, 2017年)以运行平均值与平均值最接近者为例;原型(Snell等人, 2017年)以该平均值最接近者为例;不确定性(Lewis & Gale, 1994年)以模型最不确定者为例;随机抽取一致. 在网络设置中,我们专注于精度对步曲线(AUC)下的区域,这个曲线奖励每个步骤正确,而不仅仅是最后一步,我们比较了四种相互竞争的方法:K中心贪婪,放牧,以及上面的原型,以及水库采样(Vitter,1985年),它保持了所有数据的统一样本. 在这两种情况下,我们还报告三个参考点。 所有可用的真实数据都有甲骨文微调, 并监控了GradMM蒸馏, 带有我们无标签方法从未见过的地面真实标签。 它们共同给出上界,而没有微调的零射线模型给出下界.

blocks.en: 4.2 Offline label-free gradient matching beats competing methods
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 离线无标签梯度匹配比对竞争方法

blocks.en: We benchmark OLGA, setting k = 100 k{=}100 for its label-free group distribution objective, against the supervised objective (GradMM) and the five competing methods in the offline setup, where the full data pool is available at once. Each task starts from 50 real anchors, which we distill into a compact synthetic set of 5 examples and fine-tune phi-1.5 on, evaluating on the held-out validation split of each dataset. This is a 90% reduction, which creates the extreme-compression regime we target.
blocks.zh: 我们参照监督目标(GradMM)和离线设置的五种相互竞争的方法,将无标签群体分布目标设定为k=100kXX100,同时提供完整的数据库。 每项任务都从50个真正的锚开始,我们从这个锚上提炼成一套由5个实例组成的紧凑的合成器,并对每个数据集的搁置验证分解进行评估。 这是一个90%的削减, 创造了极端压迫制度 我们的目标。

blocks.en: Figure 2 (a) reports classification accuracy on each dataset. OLGA is the strongest label-free method, beating the strongest competing method on four of the five datasets and by 10.2 points on average. The gap is widest on IMDB, where OLGA scores 89.5 against 72.1 for the strongest competitor, and narrowest on Rotten Tomatoes, at 4.1 points (74.5 against 70.4). The one exception is TwitterEmotion, which is hard for every method, and where OLGA reaches just 56.5, on par with the competing methods. Overall, even without labels, gradient matching keeps enough signal to compress a dataset into a handful of synthetic examples that train a model better than any subset of real examples can. Table 1 shows two distilled examples next to the real examples they borrow their phrasing from, and Appendix A5 one for each of the other datasets. Appendix A2 lists exact values for Figure 2 (a).
blocks.zh: 图2(a)报告每个数据集的分类准确性。 OLGA是最强的无标签方法,在五个数据集的4个上击败了最强的相竞方法,平均击败10.2分. 互联网电影数据库(IMDB)上差距最大,OLGA对最强竞争对手的成绩为89.5比72.1,对罗腾番茄最窄,得分4.1分(74.5比70.4). 唯一例外是TwitterEmotion, 对每一种方法都很难, 总体而言,即使没有标签,梯度匹配也保持足够的信号,可以将一个数据集压缩成少数合成实例,比任何子集真实实例都更好地训练一个模型. 表1显示它们借用的真实例子旁边的两个提炼的例子,附录A5则显示其他数据集各一个。 附录A2列出了图2(a)的确切值。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Across five datasets, OLGA beats every competing method on average in both the offline and online setups, and comes close to the supervised upper bound in the online one. (a) Offline methods reduce 50 real examples to 5, and we report the held-out accuracy of phi-1.5 fine-tuned on them. (b) Online data arrives over a sequence of steps, each method keeps a memory of only 5 examples, and we report stream-AUC, the area under the accuracy-versus-step curve.
blocks.zh: 图2:在5个数据集中,OLGA平均在离线和在线设置中击败所有相互竞争的方法,并接近在线设置中受监督的上界. (a) 离线方法将50个实际例子减少到5个,我们报告说,经过微调的phi-1.5准确性被搁置。 (b) 在线数据通过一系列步骤到达,每种方法只保存5个实例的内存,我们报告流-AUC,即精度对步曲线下的区域。

blocks.en: 4.3 Online gradient matching with memory beats continual selection
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 在线梯度匹配内存 连续选择

blocks.en: We benchmark OLGA, setting m = 5 m{=}5 for the rehearsal memory and cascaded merge budgets, across all five datasets in an online setup of T = 10 T{=}10 steps ( 8 8 for IMDB). At each step, 50 anchors arrive and are distilled into 5 synthetic examples, which are then folded into the memory by the cascaded merge. At each step, phi-1.5 is fine-tuned on the resulting memory and evaluated on the held-out validation set.
blocks.zh: 我们以OLGA为基准,为预演内存和连锁合并预算设定 m = 5 m{=} 5,在T = 10 T{=}10步(IMDB 8 8步)的在线设置中覆盖所有五个数据集. 在每个步骤上,50个锚都到达并蒸馏成5个合成实例,然后通过级联合并折叠成内存. 在每个步骤上,phi-1.5都会对产生的内存进行微调,并在被搁置的验证集中进行评估.

blocks.en: Figure 2 (b) reports the online stream-AUC of the fine-tuned phi-1.5 on each dataset. Averaged over the five datasets, Online GradMM and OLGA finish 8.5 and 6.6 points above k-center, the strongest competing method overall at 67.0. The two are within two points of each other, so removing the labels costs little. Across datasets the biggest gain for both comes on RT-Polarity, roughly 10 points over the best competing method there. The shortfalls are all on the label-free side, where OLGA only draws level with the best competing method on TwitterEmotion and comes in 4.2 points behind it on SST-2. Appendix A3 lists exact values for Figure 2 (b).
blocks.zh: 图2(b)报告每个数据集经过微调的phi-1.5的在线流-AUC。 平均在5个数据集上,Online GradMM和OLGA完成在k-center上方的8.5和6.6点,这是相互竞争的最强方法,总体为67.0. 两者在两个点之内,所以去掉标签的成本很少. 整个数据集最大的收益来自RT-Polity, 比那里最好的竞争方法高出大约10分。 缺点都出现在无标签的一侧,OLGA只用在TwitterEmotion上的最佳竞争方法画平面,并在SST-2上以4.2分的后方出现. 附录A3列出了图2(b)的确切值。

blocks.en: 4.4 Hybrid compression pipeline
blocks.zh: 4.4 混合压缩管道

blocks.en: We explore whether a mix of selection and distillation exists that lets cheap selection take the early, easy part of compression and leaves only the extreme end to distillation, and how such a mix compares against alternatives. In our setup, a batch of B = 1,000 B{=}1{,}000 real examples arrives, selection trims it to K = 50 K{=}50 , and distillation turns those into the m = 5 m{=}5 examples we keep and train on. This achieves a 99.5% compression rate overall. We call this two-stage route Hybrid , and compare it against two alternatives. Direct drops the middle stage and goes from B B straight to m m in a single step. Double keeps both stages but runs the second one the same way as the first. Across all three routes, the distillation stage runs either GradMM or OLGA, and selection is done by uniform sampling.
blocks.zh: 我们探索是否存在一种选择和蒸馏的组合,让廉价的筛选占据压缩的早期,容易的部分,只留下蒸馏的极端,以及这种组合如何与替代品相比. 在我们的设定中,一批B = 1000 B{=}1{,}000个真实的例子到达, 选择修饰它到K = 50 K{=}50, 蒸馏把那些变成m = 5 m{=}5的例子,我们保持并训练。 这总体实现了99.5%的压缩率. 我们称之为两阶段的混合路线, 并将其与两种选择相比较。 直接放下中间舞台,在单步内从B B 直达米. 双关保持两个阶段,但运行第二个阶段与第一个阶段相同. 在所有三条路线上,蒸馏阶段要么运行GradMM,要么运行OLGA,选择通过统一的取样进行.

blocks.en: Table 2 compares the accuracy of the three routes in the offline setting, where the whole compression happens once over a static pool, and Table 2 compares what each route costs in time. With labels, the hybrid pipeline is the strongest route, averaging 86.0 percent across the five datasets, ahead of GradMM-Direct at 82.7 and GradMM-Double at 73.9, while costing less than distilling the whole batch directly or in two steps. This confirms that selecting early, while the compression is still easy, and distilling only at the extreme end is the more effective way through the bottleneck, and the cheaper one too. Without labels, the same funnel becomes a trade-off rather than a gain: OLGA-Hybrid falls short of OLGA-Direct by only 0.9 points on average while running 30% faster, which puts the two routes on par and makes the choice between them a balance of accuracy against time. What holds for both objectives is the lead over selection: GradMM-Hybrid and OLGA-Hybrid beat the selection-only routes on average, 86.0 and 80.0 against 73.4 for Selection-Double and 66.6 for Selection-Direct.
blocks.zh: 表2比较了离线设置中三条路线的准确性,即整个压缩一次发生在静电池上,表2比较了每个路线的时间成本. 有标签,混合管道是最强的路线,平均86.0%跨五个数据集,领先GradMM-Direct,82.7和GradMM-Double,73.9,而成本低于直接或分两步对整批货物进行蒸馏。 这证实了早期选择,而压缩仍然容易,而仅在极端进行蒸馏,是穿过瓶颈的更有效方式,也是更便宜的方式. 没有标签,同一个漏斗就成了取舍而不是收益:OLGA-Hybrid平均比OLGA-Direct少0.9分,同时运行速度快30%,这使得两条航线处于平价状态,并在它们之间做出精确度与时间的平衡选择. 两个目标都是领先于选择:GradMM-Hybrid和OLGA-Hybrid平均胜过只选择路线,86.0和80.0胜73.4胜于选择-Double,66.6胜于选择-Direct.

blocks.en: The online half of Table 2 shows that GradMM-Hybrid performs best, with an average stream-AUC of 78.4. GradMM-Hybrid beats GradMM-Direct by 3.1 points and OLGA-Hybrid beats OLGA-Direct by 2.1 points, while distilling only 50 examples at each step instead of 1,000. Every route that uses distillation also beats selection alone on average, and the best of them leads the strongest selection-only route (72.5) by 5.9 points.

blocks.en: The group-distribution loss ℓ grp \ell^{\mathrm{grp}} introduced in OLGA is not the only way to turn the model’s own probabilities into a label-free signal. We compare it against two alternatives (Figure 3 (a)). The pseudo-token signal appends the prompt “ In a single word:” and takes the most likely next token as its target, letting the model label itself in one word. The self-information signal finds the token in each sequence that the frozen model predicted least well and takes it as the target, on the view that this token carries most of what makes the example distinctive. Appendix A6 describes both signals further and gives their exact formulations.
blocks.zh: OLGA中引入的组分配损失 lgrp\ell^{\mathrm{grp}}}并不是将模型自身概率转化为无标签信号的唯一方法. 我们将其与两个备选案文进行比较(图3(a))。 伪键信号附加了“在一个单词中:”并以最可能的下一个符号作为其目标,使模型本身以一个词标注。 自我信息信号在每个序列中找到被冻结的模型预测得最差的符号,并把它当作目标,认为这个符号携带了大多数使该例子具有独特性的东西. 附录A6进一步描述了这两个信号,并给出了它们的确切配方.

blocks.en: Figure 4 compares the three signals. At m = 5 m{=}5 , group-distribution averages 75.5 percent across the five datasets, ahead of pseudo-token (74.1) and self-information (72.2), and it is the steadiest as the budget grows. The tokens each signal aims at help explain why. Pseudo-token aims at only 18 distinct tokens, spread over just 3.1 bits of entropy, so its training signal keeps pushing in the same few directions, while self-information spreads over 47 tokens (5.5 bits) and group-distribution over 100 (6.6 bits). The alternatives are also up to five times slower to run.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Keeping a deployed language model current calls for updates that run on a handful of examples carrying the training signal of all data seen so far. OLGA extends gradient matching for text in three directions: removing the need for labels, following a data stream through a running rehearsal memory, and cutting cost with a hybrid pipeline that selects before it distills. Across five text classification datasets, it outperforms every competing method on average in both the offline and online settings, and our experiments show that each of the three directions matters. Together, they make continual updating of a language model accurate, affordable, and independent of ground-truth labels, offering a practical path toward keeping deployed language model applications current.
blocks.zh: 保持一个已部署的语言模型的当前更新要求以少数例子为例,这些例子载有迄今看到的所有数据的培训信号。 OLGA将文本的梯度匹配扩展为三个方向: 取消对标签的需求,通过运行的排练内存来完成数据流, 并用混合管道在蒸馏前选择成本. 在五个文本分类数据集中,它平均比在离线和在线环境下的每一种相互竞争的方法都要好,我们的实验表明,这三个方向都很重要。 它们共同不断更新准确、负担得起和独立于地面真实标签的语言模型,为保持所部署的语言模型应用程序流畅提供了一个切实可行的途径。

blocks.en: Appendix A7 Alternative selectors for the hybrid pipeline
blocks.zh: 附录A7 混合管道替代选择器

blocks.en: The first stage of the hybrid pipeline only has to thin out the incoming batch, so any selection method can run it. As in Section 4.5 , we replace uniform sampling in the first stage of the offline GradMM-Hybrid route with k-center, the strongest selection method of Figure 2 (b), and keep everything else fixed. Table 11 gives the per-dataset results. Uniform sampling is ahead of k-center on all five datasets, from 2.0 points on IMDB to 8.3 on TwitterEmotion, and is also faster to run. This supports keeping the original distribution of the data at the selection stage and leaving the rest of the compression to distillation.

blocks.en: The running memory can absorb each arriving batch in more than one way. blocks.en: Appendix A9 Memory learnability diagnostics
blocks.zh: 附录A9 记忆可学习性诊断

blocks.en: This section asks whether a cheap property of the memory can tell in advance how well the model will do on the stream, without fine-tuning on it. We measure two such properties of each method’s memory on every dataset. Feature discriminability measures how well the memory’s examples separate the classes in the model’s feature space, and gradient contrast measures how different the training gradients of the classes are. Figure 5 plots each against stream-AUC. Neither one predicts stream-AUC on its own. The least-squares fits explain almost none of the variation, with R 2 R^{2} of 0.03 for feature discriminability and 0.08 for gradient contrast, and memories with nearly the same score on either property end up tens of points apart in stream-AUC. The gradient-matching memories and the oracle do sit in the high-accuracy region, but so do some selection memories whose scores are very different from theirs. How well a memory trains the model therefore cannot be read off a single cheap property, and the choice of method, rather than a proxy score, has to drive how the memory is built.
